eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-80 years
* Participation in endurance sports (≥4 hours/week)
* Diagnosis of atrial fibrillation
* Capturing training data through commercially available platforms (e.g. Strava, TrainingPeaks, …) or willingness to start collecting training data and working with these commercially available platforms prospectively

Exclusion Criteria:

* No training data available
* History of cardiovascular disease (including ischemic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, valvular heart disease, primary electrical disorders, or congestive heart failure)
* Active smoking
